description: Briefly poll an owned world, model, asset pack, material, material pack, Image, or video/audio asset until it reaches a terminal status or an optional asset stage, then return current status with chatUrl, typed failure diagnostics, safe moderationCategories when available, retry guidance, and nextSteps. timeout_ms is optional, defaults to 30000, and must not exceed 60000; omit it to use the default. until_stage: "preview" waits for renderable preview content; until_stage: "final" waits for final downloadable output eligibility where the asset type supports it. Images and video/audio are final-only, so use until_stage: "final" for them. Emits MCP progress notifications using workflowStage, asset status, and assetStage while waiting. Use this for a short wait, then call get_asset or wait_for_status again later instead of holding a long request. For code-project imports, follow nextSteps after final status to get_asset_artifact_manifest. When presenting the result to the user, show chatUrl as the Open in Mint link. Render previewImageUrl inline only when useful; do not show raw CDN, thumbnail, pano, mesh, material map, Image file, audio file, asset id, provider URL, storage key, provider ID, or Trigger ID as text.

timeout_ms.description: Optional short-wait timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 and must not exceed 60000; omit it to use the default.

name: wait_for_status
title: Wait For Status
